title: FlashVSR+ Video Upscaler
description: FlashVSR+ one-step diffusion video super-resolution on Apple Silicon, powered by the vpipe engine (Metal). Choose Turbo (speed, hybrid attention) or Base (quality) variants, upscale any video to 1080p/4K targets with color-preserving restoration, and compare before/after with a slider. Video runs as background jobs with live progress and a result library.
